one_line: A Satavahana-era stone sculptor at the Kanaganahalli stupa, carving royal portraits and reliefs in limestone around the 1st century BCE–2nd century CE.

appearance.age_look: mid-20s, lean and wiry build from manual labour
appearance.face: oval face with a straight nose, medium-brown Deccan complexion, high cheekbones, faint stone-dust freckles, and calm, focused eyes; default expression is earnest concentration with a hint of quiet pride.
appearance.hair: thick black hair, oiled and combed back into a short, neat knot at the back of the head (small kudumi) secured with a simple dark wooden pin; a narrow off-white cloth band wraps once around the forehead as a sweatband.
appearance.costume: He wears a knee-length off-white cotton uttariya wrapped over both shoulders and torso like a snug working robe, its edge bordered with a thin dull-red stripe, over a plain ankle-length unbleached cotton dhoti tightly wrapped and knotted at the front, with a practical working fit; his right shoulder’s cloth is slightly tucked to free his chisel arm, and he has a narrow brown leather belt at the waist from which a small cloth pouch hangs; simple dark wooden sandals with thong straps protect his feet; accessories are minimal—a small copper bangle on the left wrist and a beaded rudraksha-style necklace, with a light layer of stone dust often visible on his garments.
appearance.signature: A pale grey limestone relief slab (about chest-wide) held upright with one hand while the other grips a short iron chisel and small wooden mallet, both worn and smooth from use.

ref_desc: A lean mid-20s Deccan sculptor with medium-brown skin, black hair in a small back knot with an off-white forehead band, wearing an off-white cotton uttariya and ankle-length dhoti with dull-red borders and wooden sandals, holding a grey limestone relief slab plus iron chisel and wooden mallet in a palette of off-white, dull red, brown, grey and black.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a Satavahana-era Deccan sculptor: a lean mid-20s man with medium-brown skin, an oval face, calm focused eyes, and black hair oiled back into a small knot at the back of his head, secured with a dark wooden pin and wrapped once with a narrow off-white forehead cloth band; he wears a knee-length off-white cotton uttariya wrapped snugly over both shoulders and torso like a working robe, its edge bordered with a thin dull-red stripe, slightly tucked at the right shoulder to free his arm, over an ankle-length unbleached cotton dhoti tightly wrapped and knotted at the front, plus a narrow brown leather belt with a small cloth pouch, a beaded rudraksha-style necklace, a copper bangle on his left wrist, and simple dark wooden sandals, his garments lightly dusted with stone powder; in his hands he holds a pale grey limestone relief slab upright in one hand while gripping a short iron chisel and small wooden mallet in the other, with the overall colour palette of off-white, dull red, brown, stone grey and black, shown from head to toe with clear views of face, hairstyle, costume details and tools.
